review.provenance: Parent relayed independent early review; not a self-verdict
review.finding: Git replacements substitute completion/approval text and ancestry under the original reported candidate SHA

mechanism: All documented Git observations use a subshell helper: remove inherited GIT_* variables, invoke git --no-replace-objects, disable fsmonitor; comparison still disables external diff/textconv. Caller environment and repository metadata are preserved.
limits: Trusted shell and Git executable assumed; not a sandbox for arbitrary tools
Original fresh-context raw evidence has not been independently verified
No new agent scenario or review PASS claimed
Shared upstream runtime/control/manifest changes adopted unchanged by merge; no lane-authored shared runtime changes
remaining: Independent review of exact new candidate
